home.eyebrow.en: Battery science · Machine learning · Industrial translation
home.eyebrow.zh: 电池科学 · 机器学习 · 产业落地

home.role.en: Battery scientist with 14+ years at Argonne National Laboratory. Now bridging electrochemistry and ML for industrial-scale energy storage.
home.role.zh: 电池科学家，于美国能源部阿贡国家实验室任职 14 年半（2009–2023）。当前致力于将电化学与机器学习结合，服务于工业级储能。

home.lead.en: R&D 100 Award (2014) for redox-shuttle technology. 99 peer-reviewed publications (97 SCI + 2 book chapters), 28 patents & applications (25 issued), 4,700+ citations. Built and led cross-institution Sprint teams under JCESR (DOE BES).
home.lead.zh: 2014 年 R&D 100 大奖获得者（氧化还原穿梭剂技术）。99 项同行评议论著（97 篇 SCI + 2 章著作）、28 项美国专利及申请、4,700+ 引用。曾在 JCESR（DOE BES 能源前沿研究中心）领导跨机构 Sprint 团队。

about.lead.en: Battery scientist and data engineer. After 14+ years at Argonne National Laboratory developing redox flow batteries, Li-ion electrolytes, and silicon-anode binders, now applying machine learning to industrial energy-storage problems.
about.lead.zh: 电池科学家与数据工程师。曾在阿贡国家实验室任职 14 年半，从事液流电池、锂离子电池电解液、硅负极粘合剂等方向研究；当前致力于将机器学习应用于工业级储能问题。

page.patents.eyebrow.zh: 已授权 28 项 · 申请待补

page.patents.lead.en: 28 issued US patents in flow battery chemistries, redox shuttles, Li-ion electrolytes, and silicon-anode binders, plus pending applications in membrane / lithium-recovery and electrolyte-solvent directions.
page.patents.lead.zh: 已授权 28 项美国专利，覆盖液流电池化学、氧化还原穿梭剂、锂离子电解液、硅负极粘合剂等方向；另有膜材料 / 锂回收与电解液溶剂方向的待审申请。

page.projects.eyebrow.zh: 阿贡国家实验室 DOE 资助电池研究

page.projects.lead.en: DOE-funded battery research at Argonne National Laboratory across four interconnected lines: redox flow batteries, silicon anodes, autonomous ML-driven discovery, and membrane / lithium-recovery technology. Bridging fundamental molecular design to industrial translation.
page.projects.lead.zh: 在阿贡国家实验室开展的 DOE 资助电池研究，涵盖四个交织的方向：液流电池、硅负极、自主式 ML 驱动发现、膜材料与锂回收。从基础分子设计到产业转化的全链条工作。

page.talks.lead.en: Invited keynotes and conference talks across the major battery-research venues — MRS, ECS, IBS, ICESI — plus 38 conference abstracts (primarily ECS Meeting Abstracts and APS Bulletin).
page.talks.lead.zh: 在 MRS、ECS、IBS、ICESI 等主要电池研究会议的特邀与会议报告，另有 38 篇会议摘要（主要来自 ECS Meeting Abstracts 与 APS Bulletin）。

page.press.lead.en: Selected coverage of research at Argonne — flow batteries, redox shuttles, self-reporting redoxmers, and AI-driven materials discovery — across the laboratory's own press room, science press syndication, and industry trade publications.
page.press.lead.zh: 阿贡时期研究工作的公开报道精选，涵盖液流电池、氧化还原穿梭剂、自报告 redoxmer、AI 驱动材料发现等方向，来源包括实验室自家新闻、科技媒体转载与行业期刊。

page.ai.eyebrow.zh: AI · 工具 · 工业 ML

page.ai.lead.en: Most ML-for-materials systems are built by engineers without chemistry intuition; most battery scientists never operate production ML pipelines. The combination — a senior chemist with R&D 100 winning flow-battery work and three years of insurance-grade ML at scale — is rare, and is the foundation for industrial-scale energy-storage AI going forward.
page.ai.lead.zh: 大多数材料 AI 系统由没有化学直觉的工程师搭建；大多数电池科学家从未运营过工业级 ML 管线。两者兼具——R&D 100 获奖资深化学家 + 三年工业级 ML 实战经验——这种组合罕见，也是未来工业级储能 AI 工作的基础。
